players.product: wafer-level burn-in systems (FOX) with WaferPak full-wafer contactors, and Sonoma package-level burn-in, for AI accelerators and silicon photonics

quarterly_data.signal: Aehr's backlog was $80.6 million at May 29, 2026, compared with $15.2 million at May 30, 2025. Backlog consists of product orders for which confirmed purchase orders have been received and which are scheduled for shipment within 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $80.6 million at May 29, 2026 (vs $15.2 million at May 30, 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: During fiscal 2026 Aehr worked with a long-time established subcontractor (not named) to do final integration and test of its Sonoma package-level test and burn-in systems, and in its fourth fiscal quarter signed off on the qualification of direct shipments of Sonoma systems to customers; the 10-K says this additional manufacturing capacity significantly increases the company's total manufacturing capacity. Final assembly and testing are otherwise performed at its principal manufacturing facility in Fremont, California.
